alerts.title: Viral load monitoring overdue on DTG-based regimen
alerts.message: Guidelines state that patients on two NRTIs plus DTG should have viral load checked every 6 months, with 12-monthly testing only if VL is below 50 copies/mL for over one year with reliable adherence. The latest viral load of 40 copies/mL was recorded on 2025-10-01, 113 days before this visit, which is within the 6-month interval, so no monitoring gap is present. Creatinine was last recorded 478 days before the visit (2024-10-01), with no renal function monitoring documented since, while the patient remains on TDF, which requires periodic renal monitoring not captured in the excerpts provided.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm the next viral load is scheduled within 6 months of 2025-10-01, and order an up-to-date creatinine and renal function check given the last value is over 15 months old while on TDF.
